+# SPDX-License-Identifier: Apache-2.0
+# SPDX-FileCopyrightText: Copyright contributors to the vLLM project
+"""Query overlap of a K3.1 DSA layer. The indexer path (wq_b -> DsaIndex -> scoring
+and top-k, under DCP the top-k merge and the local slots) needs only the normalized
+q_c rows of the query, so the rest of the query stage leaves the critical path:
+
+  QueryNorm   q_a RMSNorm -> the q_c rows, on the main stream ahead of wq_b
+              (bit-identical to MlaQuery's: its scalar form below tiled_from rows,
+              its tiled kernel's packed FP32 pairs from there)
+  MlaQuery    Q_B, W_UK absorption, the query rows, the MLA KV insert and, under
+              DCP, the q mailbox publish, on a side stream (``store_qc=False``,
+              ``poll=False``)
+  QueryWait   DCP: the q mailbox poll (until every rank's heads landed) after the
+              MlaQuery on the side stream, a few CTAs instead of MlaQuery's grid
+
+The main stream joins the side stream just before the sparse core."""
+
+from functools import cache
+
+import cutlass
+import cutlass.cute as cute
+import torch
+from cutlass import Float32
+
+from ..common.policy import batch_table
+from ..common.primitives import (
+    alloc,
+    at,
+    bf16x2,
+    fma,
+    fma2,
+    launch,
+    load_bf16x8,
+    load_volatile,
+    load_words,
+    mul2,
+    published,
+    query_norm_rsqrt,
+    store_words,
+    unpack_bf16,
+    warp_sum,
+)
+from ..mla.query import Q_SENT, tiled_from
+
+# serial: MlaQuery (q_c, publish and poll) -> wq_b -> ... -> core (one stream).
+# fork: QueryNorm -> wq_b -> ... -> join -> core, MlaQuery (+ QueryWait) forked.
+# wait: MlaQuery (q_c, publish) -> wq_b -> ... -> QueryWait -> core (one stream).
+# front: as fork, with a fused index front for QueryNorm -> wq_b -> DsaIndex: the
+#   cluster IndexFront (front.py) up to 40 rows, then IndexFrontMma (front_mma.py).
+# late (TP, fused indexer): QueryNorm -> wq_b -> ... -> IndexerSelect -> MlaQuery ->
+#   core on one stream: MlaQuery reads none of the indexer's outputs, so it starts
+#   with the select (PDL) and waits for it only at its end (MlaQuery(late=True)).
+# late_front: as late, with the fused index front for QueryNorm -> wq_b -> DsaIndex.
+# Under serial the q_c rows feed IndexFrontMma in place of wq_b -> DsaIndex
+# (prepared.FUSED_INDEX).
+# Per topology and batch of rows, measured on the integrated stack (GB300, fp8 KV,
+# whole DSA layer, us; the fused indexer at TP, the #63 DCP top-k merge under DCP):
+# - TP8 (fused indexer; with prims_ts' PDL hold, attn_fi.py): late_front wins up to 20
+#   rows (merged stack, one allocation, 8K/32K/128K/AgentX: R1 q5 35.1/39.0/49.5/35.1
+#   vs serial with IndexFrontMma from q_c 38.7/42.4/52.9/39.1 and fork
+#   40.9/45.2/55.4/41.7; q1 M1-M16 by 1-4 us over serial); at 21-29 rows serial and
+#   fork tie within run-to-run noise (+-2 us); from 30 rows fork wins (R8 q5 by 3-8
+#   us; MlaQuery outlasts the select under late, IndexFrontMma's 128 CTAs crowd
+#   the forked MlaQuery under front).
+# - DCP8 (the #63 merge; IndexFrontMma from 41 rows): front beats fork by 2.5-6.5 us
+#   at 5-64 rows at every context. At 80-320 rows it is context-dependent: front
+#   wins at 128K / AgentX (R64 -10.2 / -0.4, R48 -7.5 / -5.0, R32 -3.4 / -2.6 us)
+#   and loses at 8K / 32K (R26 +6.3 / +4.4, R48 +4.3 / +1.6 us); front everywhere
+#   (the long-context AgentX workload). wait with IndexFrontMma lost 1-8 us.
+# - TP1 (DEP, 96 heads: the split query, mla.query_wide): fork (QueryNorm, then the
+#   Q_B projection and MlaAbsorb on the side stream beside the indexer path).
+# - DCP8 with the split query (mla.query_wide, from SPLIT_FROM rows): its four
+#   kernels (QueryNorm, Q_B, MlaAbsorb publishing, QueryWait) forked beside the
+#   index front and the persistent scorer wait for SMs the indexer holds, so at the
+#   widest batches they run ahead of the indexer on the main stream ("wait":
+#   QueryWait before the core). GB300 DCP8 whole layer, us (32K / AgentX): R8 fork
+#   117.2 / 120.8, wait 123.4 / 127.5; R16 fork 134.0, front 137.7, wait 142.1
+#   (MlaQuery front 147.0); R32 fork 169.9 / 184.7, wait 183.6 / 190.6; R48 wait
+#   207.5 / 219.4, fork 233.6 / 249.8; R64 wait 250.0, fork 295.5, front 320.1
+#   (MlaQuery front 271.8).
+QUERY_OVERLAP = {
+    "tp": "1-20:late_front,21-320:fork",
+    "dcp": "1-320:front",
+    "dcp_split": "1-239:fork,240-320:wait",
+    "tp1": "1-320:fork",
+}
+# TP without the fused indexer (the late modes follow its select): the TP table the
+# stack ran before them.
+QUERY_OVERLAP_UNFUSED = "1:front,2-9:serial,10:front,11-320:fork"
+MODES = ("serial", "fork", "wait", "front", "late", "late_front")
+LATE = ("late", "late_front")  # TP with the fused indexer only (else: fork, front)
+NORM = ("fork", "late")  # QueryNorm writes the q_c rows
+FRONT = ("front", "late_front")  # IndexFront
+
+
+# The modes of the split query (TP1): QueryNorm ahead of it, or forked beside it.
+WIDE_MODES = ("serial", "fork")
+
+
+def overlap_for(batch, policy=None, dcp=False, wide=False, split=False):
+    """The query overlap mode of ``batch`` rows: ``policy`` is a mode or a
+    "rows:mode,..." table (default QUERY_OVERLAP of the topology, ``dcp``;
+    ``wide``: the split query of TP1, WIDE_MODES only; ``split``: the split query
+    of fewer heads, under DCP its own table)."""
+    topology = "tp1" if wide else "dcp" if dcp else "tp"
+    if split and dcp and not wide:
+        topology = "dcp_split"
+    policy = policy or QUERY_OVERLAP[topology]
+    mode = policy if policy in MODES else batch_table(policy).get(batch, "fork")
+    modes = WIDE_MODES if wide else MODES
+    if mode not in modes:
+        raise ValueError(f"Kimi K3.1 DSA query overlap {mode!r}: expected {modes}")
+    return mode
+
+
+@cache
+def side_stream(device_index):
+    """The DSA layers' query side stream of a device."""
+    return torch.cuda.Stream(device=device_index)
+
+
+class QueryNorm:
+    """The q_a RMSNorm of ``batch`` rows of the packed projection -> q_c [B, 1536]
+    BF16, exactly as MlaQuery (``heads``) computes it for the same batch."""
+
+    def __init__(self, heads: int, batch: int):
+        self.batch = batch
+        self.wide = batch >= tiled_from(heads)
+        self.grid = -(-batch // 8) if self.wide else batch
+
+    @cute.jit
+    def __call__(self, *args):
+        launch(self.tiled if self.wide else self.kernel, args, self.grid, 256)
+
+    @cute.kernel
+    def kernel(self, args):
+        """One row per CTA: 8 columns per thread, MlaQuery.kernel's FMA order."""
+        qkv, w_qa, qc, eps = args
+        tid, _, _ = cute.arch.thread_idx()
+        row, _, _ = cute.arch.block_idx()
+        lane, warp = tid % 32, tid // 32
+        smem = cutlass.utils.SmemAllocator()
+        ss = alloc(smem, Float32, 8)
+        weights = load_bf16x8(w_qa.iterator + (tid % 192) * 8)
+        cute.arch.griddepcontrol_wait()
+        cute.arch.griddepcontrol_launch_dependents()
+        xv = cute.make_rmem_tensor(8, Float32)
+        total = Float32(0)
+        if tid < 192:
+            values = load_bf16x8(at(qkv, row, tid * 8), mutable=True)
+            for i in cutlass.range_constexpr(8):
+                xv[i] = values[i]
+                total = fma(values[i], values[i], total)
+        total = warp_sum(total)
+        if lane == 0:
+            ss[warp] = total
+        cute.arch.sync_threads()
+        if tid < 192:
+            total = Float32(0)
+            for w in cutlass.range_constexpr(8):
+                total += ss[w]
+            rr = query_norm_rsqrt(total, eps)
+            words = [
+                bf16x2(xv[i] * rr * weights[i], xv[i + 1] * rr * weights[i + 1])
+                for i in range(0, 8, 2)
+            ]
+            store_words(at(qc, row, tid * 8), tuple(words))
+
+    @cute.kernel
+    def tiled(self, args):
+        """One row per warp: 48 columns per lane, MlaQuery.tiled's packed pairs."""
+        qkv, w_qa, qc, eps = args
+        tid, _, _ = cute.arch.thread_idx()
+        tile, _, _ = cute.arch.block_idx()
+        lane, warp = tid % 32, tid // 32
+        row = tile * 8 + warp
+        gamma = []
+        for i in cutlass.range_constexpr(6):
+            gamma += list(load_bf16x8(w_qa.iterator + 256 * i + 8 * lane))
+        cute.arch.griddepcontrol_wait()
+        cute.arch.griddepcontrol_launch_dependents()
+        if row < self.batch:
+            values: list = []
+            for i in cutlass.range_constexpr(6):
+                source = at(qkv, row, 256 * i + 8 * lane)
+                for word in load_words(source, count=4, mutable=True):
+                    values += list(unpack_bf16(word))
+            zero = Float32(0), Float32(0)
+            chains = [zero, zero]  # (0, 1), (2, 3): element e feeds chain e % 4
+            for e in cutlass.range_constexpr(0, 48, 2):
+                x = values[e], values[e + 1]
+                chains[e % 4 // 2] = fma2(x, x, chains[e % 4 // 2])
+            (c0, c1), (c2, c3) = chains
+            total = warp_sum((c0 + c1) + (c2 + c3))
+            rr = query_norm_rsqrt(total, eps)
+            for i in cutlass.range_constexpr(6):
+                words = []
+                for e in cutlass.range_constexpr(8 * i, 8 * i + 8, 2):
+                    x = values[e], values[e + 1]
+                    y = mul2(mul2(x, (rr, rr)), (gamma[e], gamma[e + 1]))
+                    words.append(bf16x2(*y))
+                store_words(at(qc, row, 256 * i + 8 * lane), tuple(words))
+
+
+class QueryWait:
+    """DCP: poll the gathered q mailbox (``batch`` tokens of ``gathered`` = DCP x H
+    published heads in rows of ``q_heads``, ``q_bytes`` per element) until no 16 B
+    chunk is the sentinel. It first waits for the MlaQuery before it, so the KV
+    insert is complete too when the main stream joins."""
+
+    def __init__(self, batch, gathered, q_heads, q_bytes):
+        self.row = 36 * q_bytes  # 16 B chunks per head row
+        self.token, self.q_heads = gathered * self.row, q_heads
+        self.chunks = batch * self.token
+        self.ctas = min(32, -(-self.chunks // (256 * 8)))
+
+    @cute.jit
+    def __call__(self, *args):
+        launch(self.kernel, args, self.ctas, 256)
+
+    @cute.kernel
+    def kernel(self, args):
+        (mailbox,) = args
+        tid, _, _ = cute.arch.thread_idx()
+        cta, _, _ = cute.arch.block_idx()
+        cute.arch.griddepcontrol_wait()
+        cute.arch.griddepcontrol_launch_dependents()
+        threads: cutlass.Constexpr = self.ctas * 256
+        token, row, chunks = self.token, self.row, self.chunks
+        first = cta * 256 + tid
+        steps: cutlass.Constexpr = -(-chunks // threads)
+        for i0 in cutlass.range_constexpr(0, steps, 8):
+            n: cutlass.Constexpr = min(8, steps - i0)
+            picks = [min(first + (i0 + i) * threads, chunks - 1) for i in range(n)]
+            sources = [
+                mailbox.iterator + (c // token * self.q_heads * row + c % token) * 16
+                for c in picks
+            ]
+            loads = [load_volatile(source, count=4) for source in sources]
+            for i in cutlass.range_constexpr(n):  # the loads above are in flight
+                words = loads[i]
+                while not published(words, sentinel=Q_SENT):
+                    words = load_volatile(sources[i], count=4)

+# SPDX-License-Identifier: Apache-2.0
+# SPDX-FileCopyrightText: Copyright contributors to the vLLM project
+"""Prepared DSA core (Kimi K3.1 sparse MLA layers): the orchestration of one layer's
+stages over the packed MLA cache and the indexer cache (64-entry pages):
+
+  query stage      MlaQuery (dsa) -> wq_b -> DsaIndex (query_stage.py)
+  indexer stage    TP on FlashInfer: the fused decode indexer (indexer.py: scores,
+                   exact top-k and the physical rows in two PDL-chained kernels);
+                   DCP with the #63 merge: its scorer and local top-N select
+                   feed the merge (indexer_stage.py); else the stock decode
+                   scoring and top-k (indexer_stage.py)
+  sparse core      FlashInfer sparse MLA on a per-tensor FP8 cache (attn_fi.py:
+                   trtllm-gen or prims_ts per batch, called directly into the value
+                   stage's rows), else FlashMLA sparse on fp8_ds_mla (attn_ds.py)
+  MlaValue         W_UV and the sigmoid gate of the BF16 latent
+
+Query overlap (overlap.py, per batch of rows): the indexer path needs only q_c, so
+QueryNorm writes it (or IndexFront fuses it with wq_b and DsaIndex, front.py) on the
+main stream while MlaQuery (and, under DCP, the q mailbox poll) runs on a side
+stream that the main stream joins before the sparse core; or (TP, "late") MlaQuery
+runs on the main stream right after the fused indexer's select, beside it.
+
+Under DCP (= TP, dcp_stage.py) each rank's cache holds 1 / DCP of every context: the
+query and DsaIndex insert only the owned slots, the query publishes its heads into
+every rank's q mailbox, the indexer merges the ranks' local top-k into global token
+ids, which are filtered to this rank's slots (on FlashInfer with the #63 merge: into
+this rank's slots directly) for the sparse decode of every rank's gathered heads, and
+DcpValue merges this rank's heads by LSE.
+
+The packed projection row is [q_a 1536 | kv_a 576 | gate H*128 | wk 128 | wv 32]."""
+

+# FlashInfer sparse MLA kernels that read their inputs (prims_ts: query and rows;
+# trtllm-gen: the counts) before their PDL wait: the kernel before them is held.
+HELD_KERNELS = ("prims_ts", "trtllm")
+# On FlashInfer with a per-tensor FP8 query the fused decode indexer always runs
+# (where fused_indexer_unsupported allows): at TP instead of the stock op and the
+# conversion; under DCP feeding the #63 merge its scores, plus (up to one row per
+# SM, FusedIndexer.packs) its local top-N select as B' rows. The exact merge
+# re-reads a saturated rank's logits (more than N of a row's global top-k), so it
+# always gets the DeepGEMM-layout logits, unmodified until it returns; the B' rows
+# meet its producer contract (bit-exact #63's pack of the exact local top-N, ties
+# to the lowest key: test_fused_indexer_dcp).
+# serial query overlap: the fused index front from MlaQuery's q_c rows
+# (IndexFrontMma, normalized) instead of the split-K wq_b and DsaIndex, up to this
+# many rows (0: never). Under fork it measured no gain (QueryNorm stays a launch);
+# under DCP8 wait it lost 1-8 us (it would wait on MlaQuery's q mailbox poll).
+FUSED_INDEX = 64
+# TP on the MXFP4 indexer cache: the fused indexer serves layers whose verify steps
+# take at most this many tokens per request. At q = 8 its scorer holds one TMEM
+# accumulator (MMA and epilogue serialize) and DeepGEMM's MXFP4 logits with the
+# stock top-k win at every batch (GB300, q8, us per layer fused / stock: 32K R1 /
+# R4 / R16 / R64 23.5 / 20.1, 33.9 / 28.1, 77.1 / 60.2, 304 / 240; 128K R1 / R4 /
+# R16 / R64 38.0 / 28.6, 82.9 / 57.5, 271 / 202, 1079 / 941), while at q = 7 the
+# fused one wins everywhere (32K R4 / R16 / R64 22.5 / 27.1, 33.0 / 56.0, 102 /
+# 180; 128K 37.7 / 55.5, 80.0 / 180, 284 / 582). Under DCP the fused scorer and
+# local select stay at q = 8 (R4 / R16 within 5%, 32K R64 23.9 / 34.2).
+FUSED_TP_MAX_Q = 7
+
+
+@cache
+def compile_core(
+    batch,
+    heads,
+    pitch,
+    specs,
+    device,
+    q=1,
+    dcp=0,
+    q_heads=0,
+    sms=148,
+    fp8=False,
+    lse_base_e=True,
+    nvfp4=False,
+    overlap="serial",
+    partials="bf16",
+    cap=64,
+    release=True,
+    pushed=False,
+):
+    """CuTe kernels (query, index, value) of one batch of rows (``q`` per request).
+    ``specs``: the layouts of the weights, the MLA cache and the indexer cache.
+    Under DCP (``dcp``: its size, ``q_heads``: the gathered query's padded heads,
+    ``cap``: the DcpBox rows) the query also publishes into the q mailbox and the
+    value is DcpValue. ``fp8``: a per-tensor FP8 query [B, H, 576] and cache, and
+    the value reads FlashInfer's [B, H, 512] latent (under DCP: an FP8 q mailbox,
+    and an LSE in base e if
+    ``lse_base_e``, else base 2). ``nvfp4``: that FP8 query over an nvfp4_ds_mla
+    cache (FlashInfer prims_ts). ``overlap``: the query overlap mode (overlap.py).
+    ``partials``: the DcpBox's partial rows. ``release``: the query launches the
+    next kernel early (PDL). ``pushed``: DcpValue only merges (the sparse decode
+    pushes the rows, attn_sparse)."""
+    qnorm, kvnorm, qb, uk, uv, kv, index_kv = (
+        fake(shape, stride, dtype, 4 if dtype == torch.float32 else 16)
+        for shape, stride, dtype in specs
+    )
+    query_heads = fi_heads(heads) if fp8 else QUERY_HEADS
+    with torch.accelerator.device_index(device):
+        fakes = qnorm, kvnorm, qb, uk, kv
+        query_kernel = compile_query(
+            batch,
+            heads,
+            pitch,
+            fakes,
+            device,
+            dcp,
+            q_heads,
+            fp8,
+            nvfp4=nvfp4,
+            overlap=overlap,
+            cap=cap,
+            release=release,
+        )
+        index_kernel = compile_index(batch, heads, pitch, index_kv)
+        if dcp:
+            args = heads, dcp, batch, specs[4], pitch, device, sms, q, q_heads
+            value_kernel = compile_dcp_value(
+                *args, fp8, lse_base_e, partials, cap, pushed
+            )
+        else:
+            latent = fake((batch, heads, 512), (query_heads * 512, 512, 1))
+            gate = fake((batch, heads * 128), (pitch, 1))
+            lengths = fake((batch // q,), (1,), torch.int32, 4)
+            output = fake((batch, heads * 128), (heads * 128, 1))
+            if fp8 and value_bmm(heads, batch):  # W_UV bmm, then MlaGate
+                values = fake((heads, batch, 128), (batch * 128, 128, 1))
+                gated = MlaGate(heads, batch, q)
+                v_args: tuple = (values, gate, lengths, output, make_fake_stream())
+                value_kernel = cute.compile(gated, *v_args)
+            else:
+                value = MlaValue(heads, batch, q)
+                v_args = (latent, uv, gate, lengths, output, make_fake_stream())
+                value_kernel = cute.compile(value, *v_args)
+    return query_kernel, index_kernel, value_kernel
+
+
+@cache
+def value_rows(device, rows, heads):
+    """The W_UV bmm's value rows [H * rows * 128] BF16 of the wide TP / TP1 value
+    projection (mla.value.value_bmm), shared by every DSA layer of a device."""
+    return torch.empty(heads * rows * 128, dtype=torch.bfloat16, device=device)
+
+
+def kv_cache_blocks():
+    """The 64-token blocks the KV cache holds, if known before it is allocated (a
+    num_gpu_blocks override, or a cache already sized): a request's context fits in
+    it, so it bounds the fused indexer's logits with the longest context. None if
+    unknown (the KV cache is sized after the specialized decode is built)."""
+    from vllm.config import get_current_vllm_config_or_none
+
+    config = get_current_vllm_config_or_none()
+    if config is None:
+        return None
+    cache = config.cache_config
+    blocks = cache.num_gpu_blocks or cache.num_gpu_blocks_override
+    if not blocks or not cache.block_size:
+        return None
+    return -(-blocks * cache.block_size // INDEX_PAGE)
+
+
+class PreparedDsa:
+    """One K3.1 DSA layer. ``attention``: the KimiK3DSAAttention; ``pitches``: the
+    packed projection pitch per batch; ``queries``: the query lengths q (1 + the
+    draft length under DSpark verify) prepared for every batch divisible by q;
+    ``kernels``: the FlashInfer sparse MLA kernels to pick from per batch (default:
+    attn_fi.fi_kernels); ``prims_ts_rows``: the prims_ts plans' row capacities
+    (default: every batch on its own plan);
+    ``overlap``: a query overlap mode or "rows:mode" table (overlap.QUERY_OVERLAP).
+    """
+
+    def __init__(
+        self,
+        attention,
+        pitches,
+        scratch,
+        *,
+        queries=(1,),
+        dcp=None,
+        parity=0,
+        kernels=None,
+        overlap=None,
+        prims_ts_rows=None,
+    ):
+        from vllm.model_executor.layers.linear import UnquantizedLinearMethod
+        from vllm.v1.attention.backends.mla.flashmla_sparse import FlashMLASparseImpl
+
+        wrapper = attention.mla_attn
+        self.layer = layer = wrapper.mla_attn
+        self.impl, self.indexer = layer.impl, attention.dsa_indexer
+        # The KV format: fp8_ds_mla (FlashMLA sparse), else FlashInfer
+        # sparse's per-tensor FP8 query over a per-tensor FP8 cache (trtllm-gen or
+        # prims_ts) or an nvfp4_ds_mla one (prims_ts).
+        self.fp8 = dsa_on_flashinfer(attention)
+        self.nvfp4 = layer.kv_cache_dtype == "nvfp4_ds_mla"
+        if not (self.fp8 or isinstance(self.impl, FlashMLASparseImpl)):
+            raise ValueError(
+                "Kimi K3.1 specialized decode needs the FLASHMLA_SPARSE or "
+                f"FLASHINFER_MLA_SPARSE backend, got {type(self.impl).__name__}"
+            )
+        # The index projection runs as a BF16 split-K GEMM (stock: BF16 wq_index).
+        if not isinstance(self.indexer.wq_index.quant_method, UnquantizedLinearMethod):
+            raise ValueError(
+                "Kimi K3.1 specialized decode needs an unquantized (BF16) wq_index"
+            )
+        self.box, self.parity = dcp, parity
+        # The DcpBox mailboxes hold cap rows: a wider batch would store past them.
+        assert dcp is None or max(pitches) <= dcp.cap, (max(pitches), dcp.cap)
+        self.dcp = dcp.size if dcp is not None else 1
+        if dcp is None and not self.fp8:
+            assert (
+                self.impl._compute_fp8_decode_padded_heads(self.impl.num_heads)
+                == QUERY_HEADS
+            )
+        self.heads = layer.W_UK_T.shape[0]
+        self.device, self.pitches = layer.W_UK_T.device, pitches
+        *shared, fi_buffers = scratch
+        dcp_size = self.dcp if self.dcp > 1 else 0
+        self.query_stage = QueryStage(
+            attention, pitches, shared, self.fp8, self.nvfp4, dcp_size
+        )
+        # Under DCP on FlashInfer: the #63 merge's owned-row outputs (indexer_stage).
+        merge_rows = max(pitches) if self.dcp > 1 and self.fp8 else 0
+        self.indexer_stage = IndexerStage(self.indexer, merge_rows)
+        # ... and the NVLink candidate exchange that replaces its all-gather
+        # (topk_exchange; symmetric over the DCP group: collective, every rank
+        # builds its DSA layers in the same order).
+        self.exchange = None
+        if self.indexer_stage.local_topk:
+            args = dcp.group, self.device, dcp.size, dcp.rank, dcp.cap
+            self.exchange = reserve_exchange(*args, self.indexer_stage.local_topk)
+        self.shapes = [(b, q) for b in pitches for q in queries if b % q == 0]
+        self.fi = None
+        # The split query (mla.query_wide): TP1 (many heads) at every batch, TP8
+        # and DCP8 from SPLIT_FROM rows.
+        self.split = {
+            (b, q): runs_split(self.heads, b, dcp_size, self.fp8)
+            for b, q in self.shapes
+        }
+        self.overlaps = {
+            (b, q): overlap_for(
+                b, overlap, self.dcp > 1, self.heads >= 64, self.split[b, q]
+            )
+            for b, q in self.shapes
+        }
+        # The split query has no late mode (it follows no select) and, under DCP,
+        # no serial one (it does not poll the q mailbox: QueryWait does).
+        for shape, split in self.split.items():
+            mode = self.overlaps[shape]
+            if split and (mode in LATE or (mode == "serial" and self.dcp > 1)):
+                self.overlaps[shape] = "front" if mode in FRONT else "fork"
+        if self.fp8:
+            if kernels is None:
+                kernels = fi_kernels(layer.kv_cache_dtype)
+            dcp_size = self.dcp
+            # TP1's 96 heads run head-padded to 128 (fi_heads; the pad heads are
+            # zero), on every FlashInfer build.
+            heads = dcp.q_heads if dcp is not None else fi_heads(self.heads)
+            rows = {b: kernel_for(b, dcp_size > 1, kernels, heads) for b in pitches}
+            if dcp is not None and not self.nvfp4 and "sparse" in kernels:
+                # The specialized sparse decode (attn_sparse) where it is faster.
+                gathered = dcp.size * self.heads
+                for b in pitches:
+                    if sparse_for(b, gathered, heads):
+                        rows[b] = "sparse"
+            self.cores = {(b, q): rows[b] for b, q in self.shapes}
+            sharding = dcp_size, self.indexer.dcp_rank
+            # The merge's rows are narrower than the top-k: plan both widths.
+            merged = self.indexer_stage.local_topk
+            widths = (self.indexer_stage.dcp_rows.shape[1],) if merged else ()
+            self.fi = FlashInferCore(
+                self.impl,
+                layer,
+                heads,
+                fi_buffers,
+                rows,
+                *sharding,
+                widths=widths,
+                capacities=prims_ts_rows,
+            )
+        elif self.dcp == 1:
+            self.cores = dict.fromkeys(self.shapes, "flashmla")
+        else:
+            self.cores = dict.fromkeys(self.shapes, "dcp")
+            rows, device = max(pitches), self.device
+            padded = dcp.q_heads
+            self.rows = torch.zeros(
+                (rows, 1, padded, 512), dtype=torch.bfloat16, device=device
+            )
+            self.dummy_table = torch.zeros((rows, 1), dtype=torch.int32, device=device)
+            self.cache_lens = torch.full(
+                (rows,), self.indexer.max_model_len, dtype=torch.int32, device=device
+            )
+        self.kernels, self.overlap_kernels = {}, {}
+        self.sparse_kernels: dict = {}
+        local_topk = self.indexer_stage.local_topk
+        static = (
+            fused_indexer_static_unsupported(self.indexer, *s) for s in self.shapes
+        )
+        # TP: the stock decode indexer where it is faster (FUSED_TP_MAX_Q).
+        self.stock_indexer = (
+            self.dcp == 1
+            and getattr(self.indexer, "use_fp4_cache", False)
+            and max(queries) > FUSED_TP_MAX_Q
+        )
+        fused_tp = self.dcp == 1 and not self.stock_indexer
+        if self.fp8 and (fused_tp or local_topk) and not any(static):
+            # The fused indexer's buffers (prepare_cache), shared by every layer,
+            # sized for the longest context the KV cache can hold: reserved now, as
+            # the specialized decode is built before vLLM profiles its memory for
+            # the KV cache (only where prepare_cache can run it: its cache layout
+            # aside, the same checks).
+            reserve_fused_indexer(
+                self.indexer,
+                self.device,
+                max(pitches),
+                local_topk,
+                blocks=kv_cache_blocks(),
+            )
+        # DCP "proj" partials: every gathered head's W_UV (collective), and the
+        # rows of its bmm (dcp_stage.projected_rows).
+        self.uv_gathered = dcp.value_weights(layer.W_UV) if dcp else None
+        if self.uv_gathered is not None:
+            projected_rows(self.device, dcp.cap, dcp.size * self.heads)
+        # TP on FlashInfer: the fused decode indexer (prepare_cache; None: stock).
+        self.fused: FusedIndexer | None = None
+        # The wide value projection's rows (value_bmm), allocated before the KV
+        # cache is sized.
+        wide_values = any(value_bmm(self.heads, b) for b in pitches)
+        if self.fp8 and self.dcp == 1 and wide_values:
+            value_rows(self.device, max(pitches), self.heads)
+
+    @property
+    def query(self):
+        """This layer's query rows (FlashInfer: FP8 [B, H, 576] bytes)."""
+        return self.query_stage.query
+
+    def prepare_cache(self, kv):
+        caches = kv.view(torch.uint8), self.indexer.k_cache.kv_cache
+        weights = self.query_stage.weights
+        specs = tuple(layout(w) for w in (*weights, *caches))
+        sms = torch.cuda.get_device_properties(self.device).multi_processor_count
+        unsupported = [fused_indexer_unsupported(self.indexer, *s) for s in self.shapes]
+        fused = self.box is None and self.fp8 and not self.stock_indexer
+        fused = fused and not any(unsupported)
+        if not fused:  # the late query follows the fused indexer's select
+            # Without it (fp8_ds_mla, unsupported shapes) the TP default is the
+            # stack's table from before the late modes (QUERY_OVERLAP_UNFUSED).
+            for (batch, q), mode in self.overlaps.items():
+                if mode in LATE:
+                    mode = overlap_for(batch, QUERY_OVERLAP_UNFUSED)
+                self.overlaps[batch, q] = mode
+        for batch, q in self.shapes:
+            args: tuple = (batch, self.heads, self.pitches[batch], specs)
+            args += (self.device.index, q)
+            partials = "bf16"
+            if self.box is not None:
+                args += (self.dcp, self.box.q_heads, sms)
+                partials = self.box.mailbox(batch).format
+            lse_base_e = self.cores[batch, q] != "trtllm"  # trtllm-gen: base 2
+            overlap = self.overlaps[batch, q]
+            pushed = self.pushes(batch, q)
+            cap = self.box.cap if self.box is not None else 64
+            self.kernels[batch, q] = compile_core(
+                *args,
+                fp8=self.fp8,
+                lse_base_e=lse_base_e,
+                nvfp4=self.nvfp4,
+                overlap=overlap,
+                partials=partials,
+                cap=cap,
+                release=(batch, q) not in self.held(LATE),
+                pushed=pushed,
+            )
+            if overlap != "serial" or batch <= FUSED_INDEX:
+                self.overlap_kernels[batch, q] = self.compile_overlap(
+                    batch, q, specs[6]
+                )
+            if self.cores[batch, q] == "sparse" and batch not in self.sparse_kernels:
+                assert self.fi is not None and self.box is not None
+                gathered, box = self.dcp * self.heads, self.box
+                args = batch, gathered, box.q_heads, self.fi.topk, box.cap
+                push = (self.heads, self.dcp) if pushed else None
+                self.sparse_kernels[batch] = compile_sparse(
+                    *args, self.device.index, push=push
+                )
+        rows = max(self.pitches)
+        if fused:
+            # Every mode but the late ones has the select right before the decode
+            # (wait too: QueryWait runs only under DCP).
+            hold = self.held(tuple(m for m in MODES if m not in LATE))
+            # The select maps keys to rows of the MLA cache's pages (kv.shape[1]
+            # tokens: 64, or the hybrid model's attention page, e.g. 2048).
+            args = self.indexer, self.shapes, self.device, rows
+            self.fused = FusedIndexer(*args, hold=hold, page=kv.shape[1])
+        stage = self.indexer_stage
+        if stage.local_topk and not any(unsupported):
+            stage.fused = FusedIndexer(
+                self.indexer,
+                self.shapes,
+                self.device,
+                rows,
+                local_topk=stage.local_topk,
+                packed=True,
+                page=kv.shape[1],
+                exchange=self.exchange,
+            )
+        return self
+
+    def pushes(self, batch, q):
+        """Whether the sparse decode of (batch, q) pushes its rows into DcpValue's
+        "bf16" mailbox itself (DcpValue ``pushed``)."""
+        if self.box is None or self.cores[batch, q] != "sparse":
+            return False
+        return self.box.mailbox(batch).format != PROJECTED
+
+    def held(self, modes):
+        """The shapes on a FlashInfer kernel (HELD_KERNELS) whose overlap mode is
+        one of ``modes``: the kernel right before their sparse decode (TP: the
+        fused indexer's select, or the late query) must not launch it early.
+        prims_ts' split-KV decode launches with PDL but reads its query and rows
+        before its PDL wait, so it would read the previous layer's; trtllm-gen
+        reads its per-row counts early too (a CUDA graph with only the counts
+        poisoned before each layer hangs at 60 rows)."""
+        return {
+            shape
+            for shape, core in self.cores.items()
+            if core in HELD_KERNELS and self.overlaps[shape] in modes
+        }
+
+    def indexer_core(self, projected, batch):
+        """Top-k of the current rows into the shared buffer (stock decode scoring)."""
+        stage = self.query_stage
+        assert projected.shape[0] == batch
+        return self.indexer_stage.run(projected, stage.q_fp8, stage.head_w)
+
+    def fused_core(self, cache, metadata, batch, q, join=None):
+        """TP on FlashInfer: the fused decode indexer's physical rows, then the
+        sparse decode -> the [B, H, 512] latent. ``join``: what makes the sparse
+        decode wait for the query (run_query)."""
+        from vllm.forward_context import get_forward_context
+        from vllm.v1.attention.backends.mla.sparse_utils import flat_kv_row_view
+
+        assert self.fused is not None
+        assert metadata.block_size == self.fused.page, (
+            metadata.block_size,
+            self.fused.page,
+        )
+        decode: Any = get_forward_context().attn_metadata[self.indexer.k_cache.prefix]
+        _, block_rows = flat_kv_row_view(cache, metadata.block_size)
+        stage = self.query_stage
+        args = stage.q_fp8, stage.head_w, decode.decode, metadata.block_table
+        rows, valid = self.fused.run(*args, block_rows, batch, q)
+        assert self.fi is not None
+        if join is not None:
+            join()
+        query = self.query[:batch]
+        return self.fi.decode(query, cache, rows, valid, metadata.block_size)[0]
+
+    def sparse_core(self, cache, topk, metadata, batch, q):
+        """Sparse decode of the query rows -> the latent ([B, 64, 512]-strided on
+        fp8_ds_mla, [B, H, 512] on FlashInfer)."""
+        query = self.query[:batch]
+        if self.fi is not None:
+            return self.fi.run(query, cache, topk[:batch], metadata)[0]
+        return flashmla_core(self.impl, query, cache, topk[:batch], metadata)
+
+    def compile_overlap(self, batch, q, index_spec):
+        """The overlap kernels of a batch: (front, wait, norm). ``front``: the fused

+The #63 one-round merge (``vllm/models/kimi_k3/nvidia/ops/dcp_topk_merge``) all-gathers
+every rank's local top-N B' rows with NCCL (a 1-CTA ring all-gather of ~19 us
+at DCP8 plus its launch gap), then selects (one kernel) and rescues saturated
+rows (a second kernel). Here, instead:
+
+  push   ``IndexerLocalTopk``'s epilogue (indexer.py, ``exchange``) stores its
+         row's B' words into every rank's symmetric ``TopkExchange`` slot
+         [parity, source rank, row] as NCCL-LL pairs: each 16-byte store
+         carries two words and the call's epoch twice, ``(w0, e, w1, e)``, so
+         a reader checks each 8-byte half's epoch instead of a flag behind a
+         system fence.
+  merge  ``ExchangeMerge`` (one 512-thread CTA per row, launched early by PDL)
+         polls the W ranks' LL words of its row, then runs the #63 merge's
+         own select (``_make_radix_select``: the same keys, threshold and tie
+         rule, so the same ids and rows in the same order), its saturation
+         word and saturated-rank push (the rescue workspace of
+         ``init_dcp_topk_merge``, the same seq2 / flag protocol), and the
+         rescue's second round in the same CTA.
+
+The epoch of row t is ``epoch[t] + 1`` (``epoch``: per rank, bumped by the
+merge after it read the row); every rank runs the same calls over the same
+rows, so the epochs agree. The slot parity is the epoch's low bit: a rank can
+store call n + 1's words while a peer still reads call n's.

+        notsat = storage.notsat.get_tensor(cute.make_layout((16,)))
+        owner = storage.owner.get_tensor(cute.make_layout((16,)))

+        # Round 1: the W ranks' B' words of this row, once their epoch landed.
+        ep = epoch[row] + Int32(1)

+        part = Int64(ep & Int32(1))

+    @cute.jit

+        recv: Int64,
+        epoch: cute.Tensor,
+        xrows: Int32,
+        out: cute.Tensor,

+        block_table: cute.Tensor,

+
+@functools.cache
+def compile_merge(rows, topk, local_topk, world, block_size, emit_ids, device):

+class ExchangeMerge:

+# SPDX-License-Identifier: Apache-2.0
+# SPDX-FileCopyrightText: Copyright contributors to the vLLM project
+"""The attention input projection of a decode step, one engine per prepared row count.
+
+GB300, TP8 shard of the K3.1 KDA (6288 x 7168) and DSA (3808 x 7168) projections,
+back-to-back launches over weights larger than L2, us:
+
+  rows   KDA  split-K / warp / cuBLAS   DSA  split-K / warp / cuBLAS   (SOL KDA / DSA)
+  1           14.54 / 13.41 / 16.89          10.93 /  8.60 / 12.23      11.02 / 6.68
+  5           14.86 / 13.82 / 16.58          11.13 /  8.51 / 11.70      11.04 / 6.69
+  10          15.30 / 14.64 / 16.89           9.82 /  8.91 / 11.54      11.05 / 6.70
+  32          15.46 / 17.61 / 17.42          10.11 / 10.14 / 12.05      11.13 / 6.76
+  64          16.58 /   -   / 16.18          11.95 /   -   / 11.75      11.23 / 6.85
+  80          27.24 /   -   / 17.81          19.43 /   -   / 11.76      11.28 / 6.89
+  160         30.72 /   -   / 21.81          27.72 /   -   / 12.67      11.55 / 7.10
+  320         55.38 /   -   / 27.59          39.50 /   -   / 16.02      12.07 / 7.53
+
+so up to 16 rows the warp split-K (many small co-resident CTAs keep the weight stream
+at HBM speed), up to 64 the cluster split-K and past it cuBLAS (the split-K tiles stop
+at 64 columns and re-read the weight per column tile)."""
+
+import torch
+
+from .projection import PreparedProjection
+from .warp_splitk import (
+    _CTA_RESERVED_SMEM,
+    _SM_SMEM_BYTES,
+    PreparedWarpSplitK,
+    WarpSplitKTactic,
+    _smem_bytes,
+    check_tactic,
+)
+
+WARP_ROWS = 16  # warp split-K up to here
+SPLIT_K_ROWS = 64  # cluster split-K up to here; cuBLAS past it
+
+
+def warp_tactic(m, n, k, sms):
+    """Warp split-K tactic of ``m`` rows of an [n, k] weight: 32-row output tiles
+    when they fill at most two waves, the smallest token tile holding ``m``, 256-wide
+    K tiles and the deepest ring that keeps every wave's CTAs resident on an SM."""
+    output = 32 if n % 32 == 0 and n // 32 <= 2 * sms else 16
+    token = 8 if m <= 8 else 16 if m <= 16 else 32
+    k_tile = 256 if k % 256 == 0 and k // 256 != 2 else 128
+    ctas = (n // output) * -(-m // token)
+    resident = -(-ctas // sms)
+    best = None
+    for stages in range(2, min(16, k // k_tile) + 1):
+        t = WarpSplitKTactic(output, token, k_tile, stages, 2)
+        if resident * (_smem_bytes(t) + _CTA_RESERVED_SMEM) <= _SM_SMEM_BYTES:
+            best = t
+    if best is None:
+        best = WarpSplitKTactic(output, token, k_tile, 2, 2)
+    check_tactic(best, n, k)
+    return best
+
+
+def warp_eligible(n, k):
+    return n % 16 == 0 and k % 128 == 0 and k // 128 <= 64
+
+
+class DecodeProjection:
+    """``out[M, N] = x[M, K] @ weight[N, K]^T`` for each prepared M: warp split-K up
+    to ``WARP_ROWS``, the cluster split-K ``policies`` (M -> tactic) up to
+    ``SPLIT_K_ROWS``, cuBLAS past it. ``skinny``: an optional engine for the rows it
+    prepares (``run(x, out)`` with ``configs``)."""
+
+    def __init__(self, weight, batches, policies, skinny=None):
+        n, k = weight.shape
+        sms = torch.cuda.get_device_properties(weight.device).multi_processor_count
+        self.weight, self.engines = weight, {}
+        warp = {}
+        packed = weight.stride() == (k, 1) and weight.data_ptr() % 32 == 0
+        if warp_eligible(n, k) and packed:
+            warp = {b: warp_tactic(b, n, k, sms) for b in batches if b <= WARP_ROWS}
+        split = {
+            b: policies[b]
+            for b in batches
+            if b not in warp and b <= SPLIT_K_ROWS and b in policies
+        }
+        self.warp = PreparedWarpSplitK(weight, warp) if warp else None
+        self.split = PreparedProjection(weight, split).prepare() if split else None
+        self.kinds = {}
+        for b in batches:
+            if skinny is not None and b in skinny.configs:
+                self.kinds[b], self.engines[b] = "skinny", skinny.run
+            elif b in warp:
+                assert self.warp is not None
+                self.kinds[b], self.engines[b] = "warp", self.warp.run
+            elif b in split:
+                assert self.split is not None
+                self.kinds[b], self.engines[b] = "split_k", self.split.run
+            else:
+                self.kinds[b], self.engines[b] = "cublas", self.cublas
+
+    def cublas(self, x, out):
+        return torch.mm(x, self.weight.t(), out=out)
+
+    def engine(self, rows):
+        return self.kinds[rows]
+
+    def run(self, x, out):
+        rows = x.shape[0]
+        if self.kinds[rows] == "warp" and not _warp_operands(x, out):
+            # The warp split-K takes packed row-major, 32 B aligned operands only.
+            return self.cublas(x, out)
+        return self.engines[rows](x, out)
+
+
+def _warp_operands(x, out):
+    k, n = x.shape[1], out.shape[1]
+    return (
+        x.stride() == (k, 1)
+        and out.stride() == (n, 1)
+        and x.data_ptr() % 32 == 0
+        and out.data_ptr() % 32 == 0
+    )

+# SPDX-License-Identifier: Apache-2.0

+# flashinfer/gemm/kernels/dense_bf16_gemm_warp_splitk.py
+"""FlashInfer's cp.async-pipelined BF16 GEMM for M <= 32 whose four compute warps hold
+split-K partials (warp split-K), kernel unchanged; the autotune heuristics are dropped
+for per-shape tactics chosen by ``decode.py`` and compiled before capture.
+
+The weight streams through two cp.async loader warps with an L2 evict_first hint
+(one tile is issued before the PDL wait), the activations through one or two loader
+warps after it; four mma.sync warps each own a K quarter of every stage and reduce
+through shared memory. Small output tiles (16 or 32 weight rows) give many CTAs that
+co-reside on an SM, which is what keeps a decode projection's weight stream at HBM
+speed."""
+
+from __future__ import annotations
+
+import dataclasses
+import functools
+import math
+
+import cuda.bindings.driver as _cuda
+import cutlass
+import cutlass.cute as cute
+import torch as _torch
+from cutlass import const_expr
+from cutlass._mlir.dialects import llvm
+from cutlass.cute import experimental as cute_ext
+from cutlass.cute.nvgpu import warp
+from cutlass.cute.runtime import from_dlpack
+from cutlass.cutlass_dsl import dsl_user_op
+from cutlass.experimental import primitives as prims
+
+_MMA_SHAPE = (16, 8, 16)
+_COMPUTE_WARPS = 4
+_A_LOADER_WARPS = 2
+_A_LOADER_THREADS = _A_LOADER_WARPS * 32
+_MAX_M = 32
+# Ring depth cap: cold-read bandwidth saturates around 12 stages (96 KB in
+# flight), so deeper rings only enlarge the tactic space.
+_MAX_STAGES = 16
+# The consumer's K loop is fully unrolled; bound the tile count so JIT time and
+# code size stay proportionate (64 tiles of 256 elements = K 16384).
+_MAX_K_TILES = 64
+_SUPPORTED_OUTPUT_TILES = (16, 32)
+_SUPPORTED_TOKEN_TILES = (8, 16, 32)
+_SUPPORTED_K_TILES = (128, 256)
+_SUPPORTED_B_LOADER_WARPS = (1, 2)
+_SMEM_CAPACITY = cutlass.utils.get_smem_capacity_in_bytes("sm_100")
+# Per-SM shared memory is the per-CTA maximum plus the 1 KB the driver reserves
+# for every resident CTA; residency estimates must include that reservation.
+_CTA_RESERVED_SMEM = 1024
+_SM_SMEM_BYTES = _SMEM_CAPACITY + _CTA_RESERVED_SMEM
+_MAILBOX_GROUP_VALUES = 32
+_MAILBOX_PADDED_GROUP_VALUES = 34
+
+
+# Pad each mailbox group by two FP32 words to reduce bank conflicts.
+def _partial_offset(feature, token, token_tile: int):
+    group_rows = _MAILBOX_GROUP_VALUES // token_tile
+    return (
+        (feature % group_rows) * token_tile
+        + (feature // group_rows) * _MAILBOX_PADDED_GROUP_VALUES
+        + token
+    )
+
+
+def _a_fragment_offset(lane, compute_warp, m_iter, phase, k_tile):
+    """Element offset of one lane's A ``ldmatrix.x4`` address within a stage."""
+    linear = lane % 16 + (lane // 16) * 128 + phase * 256
+    row = linear % _MMA_SHAPE[0] + m_iter * _MMA_SHAPE[0]
+    col = linear // _MMA_SHAPE[0] + compute_warp * (k_tile // _COMPUTE_WARPS)
+    return row * k_tile + (col ^ ((row % 8) * 8))
+
+
+def _b_pair_offset(lane, compute_warp, n_iter, pair, token_tile, k_tile):
+    """Element offset of one lane's B ``ldmatrix.x4`` address within a stage."""
+    b_atom = lane % 8 + ((lane % 32) // 8) * (token_tile * 8)
+    linear = b_atom + pair * 2 * token_tile * 16 + n_iter * 8
+    row = linear % token_tile
+    col = linear // token_tile + compute_warp * (k_tile // _COMPUTE_WARPS)
+    return row * k_tile + (col ^ ((row % 8) * 8))
+
+
+@dsl_user_op
+def _ldmatrix_x4(smem, offset, *, loc=None, ip=None):
+    """``ldmatrix.x4`` of the 16-bit fragment ``offset`` elements into ``smem``."""
+    return prims.ldmatrix(
+        smem.iterator.raw_ptr() + offset,
+        num=4,
+        layout=prims.MMALayout.ROW,
+        loc=loc,
+        ip=ip,
+    )
+
+
+@dsl_user_op
+def _l2_policy_evict_first(*, loc=None, ip=None):
+    """64-bit L2 evict_first policy (fraction 1.0).
+
+    Must stay a runtime ``createpolicy``: with the equivalent constant, ptxas
+    13.0 emits the invalid ``LDGSTS ... [R+UR], desc[UR1]`` encoding.
+    """
+    return cutlass.Int64(
+        llvm.inline_asm(
+            cutlass.Int64.mlir_type,
+            [],
+            "createpolicy.fractional.L2::evict_first.b64 $0, 1.0;",
+            "=l",
+            has_side_effects=False,
+            is_align_stack=False,
+            asm_dialect=llvm.AsmDialect.AD_ATT,
+        )
+    )
+
+
+@dsl_user_op
+def _cp_async_16_with_policy(dst, src, policy, *, loc=None, ip=None):
+    """16-byte cp.async.cg global->shared carrying an L2 cache-policy hint."""
+    llvm.inline_asm(
+        None,
+        [
+            dst.toint(loc=loc, ip=ip).ir_value(loc=loc, ip=ip),
+            src.toint(loc=loc, ip=ip).ir_value(loc=loc, ip=ip),
+            policy.ir_value(loc=loc, ip=ip),
+        ],
+        "cp.async.cg.shared.global.L2::cache_hint [$0], [$1], 16, $2;",
+        "r,l,l",
+        has_side_effects=True,
+        is_align_stack=False,
+        asm_dialect=llvm.AsmDialect.AD_ATT,
+    )
+
+
+@dsl_user_op
+def _issue_weight_tile(
+    smem,
+    weight,
+    tidx,
+    output_tile_idx,
+    k_tile,
+    stage,
+    policy,
+    output_tile,

+"""RecoverSSM commit of an FP32 KDA state: one CTA per (head, request, layer).
+
+Folds the n accepted tokens of a verify window into the checkpoint as the stock
+FP32 commit (``_commit_kda_state_kernel``) does, in its association:
+
+    S_n = S_0 * D_n + sum_{t<n} (u_t * kn_t) * P_t,   P_t = prod_{t<s<n} d_s
+
+(``u_t`` the verify's corrections, ``kn_t`` the normalized recorded keys, ``d_t`` the
+per-key decays, ``D_n = P_{-1}``), and with prefix caching (``align``) also the
+boundary state S_m of the window's first m tokens.
+
+Thread c < 128 rebuilds key channel c's decays, normalized keys and suffix products
+into shared memory; then all 8 warps fold the head's [128, 128] state from global
+memory to global memory, thread 2 i + h taking keys 8 c + 4 h + [0, 4) of row i,
+so each byte of the state is read once and written once (the stock FP32 kernel
+splits a head over four CTAs that each rebuild the key operands)."""

+"""Fused replay verify (KdaFused): the RecoverSSM commit of the previous step and the
+verify of this step in one pass over the FP32 state, the verify in chunked form.
+
+Deferred RecoverSSM. After sampling, the runner no longer folds the accepted tokens
+into the checkpoint; it records per request (its request-state slot) how many of the
+last verify's tokens were accepted (``pending``). The verify records of a request
+stay in its request-indexed record slot. The next verify of that request, per
+(request, head):
+
+1. reads the checkpoint S_0 and replays the ``n = pending`` accepted tokens of the
+   previous step from its records in the commit's closed form,
+
+       S_n = S_0 * D_n + sum_{t<n} u_t (kn_t * P_t),  P_t = prod_{t<s<n} d_s,
+
+   (``u_t`` the recorded corrections, ``kn_t`` the normalized recorded keys, ``d_t``
+   the recorded gates' decays, D_n = prod_{s<n} d_s), and writes S_n back as the
+   new checkpoint (nothing to write for n = 0); the convolution window is read at
+   the offset n - 1 the commit's compaction would have rolled it by;
+2. verifies the step's q tokens from S_n in chunked (WY) form:
+   with Gamma_t = prod_{r<=t} d_r (this step's decays) and P(s, t) = Gamma_t /
+   Gamma_s = prod_{s<r<=t} d_r,
+
+       w_t = S_n (Gamma_t * k_t),         y_t = S_n (Gamma_t * q_t),
+       A_ts = k_s . (P(s, t) * k_t) (s < t),  B_ts = k_s . (P(s, t) * q_t) (s <= t),
+       u_t = beta_t (v_t - w_t - sum_{s<t} A_ts u_s),
+       o_t = y_t + sum_{s<=t} B_ts u_s,
+
+   which is the stock recurrence (S <- S diag(d_t); u_t = beta_t (v_t - S k_t);
+   S <- S + u_t k_t^T; o_t = S q_t) rewritten: the state is only read (2q
+   dot products per row, no dependent chain over the tokens), the q x q systems are
+   solved per state row from the A / B pair products;
+3. writes the new records (u_t per row, the key and raw gate per token) into the same
+   request slot (every old record is read before any is written).

+commit read and wrote it again), and the recurrence's per-token chain is gone.

+"""Persistent warp-specialized fused replay verify (KdaFusedWS): KdaFused's math

+  ...) stream each item in (projection rows and conv window by cp.async, the

+  gate projection and decays, and fill one of four operand blocks: the chunk
+  vectors Gamma_t k_t and Gamma_t q_t, the replay keys kn_t P_t and D_n, the old
+  corrections, v, beta, the output gate and the q x q pair sums;
+- the **scan group** (8 warps) takes the item's state page (bulk copy) into
+  registers (thread (g, l): rows g + 32 r, keys 4 (l + 8 c) + [0, 4)), replays and
+  stores the checkpoint, forms the 2q row dot products, solves each row's q x q
+  system (thread = row), writes the corrections and runs the gated RMSNorm.

+    """One operand block: chunk vectors (2q, the decays and later the outputs
+    alias them), replay keys (rq) and D_n, old corrections (rq), v (FP32), the
+    output gate (BF16), beta, pair sums, meta."""

+    @cute.jit
+    def stage(self, args, staging, p, item):
+        convs, xs, gs, fas, _, _, kgs, us = staging
+        head, request, slot, rec, n, offset = self.item_info(args, item)
+        if slot > 0:
+            self.stage_conv(args, convs, p, head, slot, offset)
+            self.stage_rows(args, xs, gs, fas, p, head, request)
+            if rec >= 0:
+                self.stage_records(args, kgs, us, p, head, rec)

+    @cute.jit
+    def block_sums(self, values, sums, p, count: cutlass.Constexpr):
+        lane, warp = p % 32, p // 32
+        total, selected = scatter_reduce(values, lane, count)
+        if lane % (32 // count) == 0:
+            sums[selected, warp] = total
+
+    @staticmethod
+    def quad_sum(r):
+        return (r[0] + r[2]) + (r[1] + r[3])
+
+    @cute.jit
+    def silu(self, value):
+        silu = div_full(value, Float32(1) + triton_exp(-value))
+        return Float32(BFloat16(silu))
+
+    @cute.jit
+    def decay(self, a, raw_g, dt, lower_bound):
+        """``a`` = exp(A_log)."""
+        gate = lower_bound * triton_sigmoid(a * (raw_g + dt))
+        return triton_exp(gate)

+    # ----------------------------------------------------------------- kernel
+    @cute.kernel
+    def kernel(self, args):
+        conv_state, output, corrections = args[3], args[10], args[18]
+        T: cutlass.Constexpr = self.tokens
+        H: cutlass.Constexpr = self.heads
+        RQ: cutlass.Constexpr = corrections.shape[2]
+        P2: cutlass.Constexpr = 1 << (pair_count(T) - 1).bit_length()
+        tid, _, _ = cute.arch.thread_idx()
+        cta, _, _ = cute.arch.block_idx()
+        requests: cutlass.Constexpr = output.shape[0] // T
+        total_items: cutlass.Constexpr = H * requests
+        # CTA c walks items c, c + ctas, ... (strided: CTAs running side by side
+        # take neighbouring items, so different heads and state pages, instead of
+        # all taking item j of equal contiguous ranges: with ranges a multiple of
+        # the head count every CTA reads the same head's F_B rows and the same
+        # page offset at once).
+        first, stride = Int32(cta), Int32(self.ctas)
+        count = Int32(0)
+        if cutlass.const_expr(self.strided):
+            count = (Int32(total_items) - first + stride - 1) // stride
+        else:
+            first = Int32(total_items * cta // self.ctas)
+            count = Int32(total_items * (cta + 1) // self.ctas) - first
+            stride = Int32(1)
+
+        smem = cutlass.utils.SmemAllocator()
+        page = alloc(smem, Float32, K * K, align=1024)
+        conv_type: cutlass.Constexpr = conv_state.element_type
+        xv_s = alloc(
+            smem, Float32, (4, 2 * T, K)
+        )  # decays -> Gamma k, Gamma q; outputs
+        kp_s = alloc(smem, Float32, (4, RQ, K))
+        dn_s = alloc(smem, Float32, (4, K))
+        u_s = alloc(smem, Float32, (4, RQ, K))
+        v_s = alloc(smem, Float32, (4, T, K))
+        g_s = alloc(smem, BFloat16, (4, T, K))
+        beta_s = alloc(smem, Float32, (4, 8))
+        pr_s = alloc(smem, Float32, (4, P2))
+        meta = alloc(smem, Int32, (4, META))
+        if cutlass.const_expr(self.conv_dim_first):
+            convs = alloc(smem, conv_type, (2, 3, K * self.window), align=16)
+        else:
+            convs = alloc(smem, conv_type, (2, 3, 3 * K), align=16)
+        xs = alloc(smem, BFloat16, (2, T, 3, K), align=16)
+        gs = alloc(smem, BFloat16, (2, T, K), align=16)
+        fas = alloc(smem, BFloat16, (2, T, K), align=16)
+        kgs = alloc(smem, BFloat16, (2, RQ, 2 * K), align=16)
+        us = alloc(smem, Float32, (2, RQ, K), align=16)
+        sums = alloc(smem, Float32, (2, 32, 4))
+        psums = alloc(smem, Float32, (2, 64, 4))
+        out_sums = alloc(smem, Float32, (2, 8, 4))
+        dots = alloc(smem, Float32, (K, 2 * T + 1))
+        bars = smem.allocate(cutlass.Uint64, 12)
+        state_full, state_empty, ops_full, done = bars, bars + 2, bars + 4, bars + 8
+
+        if tid == 0:
+            cute.arch.mbarrier_init(state_full, 1)
+            cute.arch.mbarrier_init(state_empty, GROUP_THREADS)
+            for blk in cutlass.range_constexpr(4):
+                cute.arch.mbarrier_init(ops_full + blk, PREP_THREADS)
+                cute.arch.mbarrier_init(done + blk, GROUP_THREADS)
+            cute.arch.mbarrier_init_fence()
+        cute.arch.barrier()
+        cute.arch.griddepcontrol_wait()
+        cute.arch.griddepcontrol_launch_dependents()
+        ops = (xv_s, kp_s, dn_s, u_s, v_s, g_s, beta_s, pr_s, meta)
+
+        if tid >= GROUP_THREADS:
+            set_max_registers(self.registers[1], increase=False)
+            w = (tid - GROUP_THREADS) // PREP_THREADS
+            p = (tid - GROUP_THREADS) % PREP_THREADS
+            staging = (
+                convs[w, None, None], xs[w, None, None, None], gs[w, None, None],
+                fas[w, None, None], sums[w, None, None], psums[w, None, None],
+                kgs[w, None, None], us[w, None, None],
+            )  # fmt: skip
+            self.prep(args, w, p, first, stride, count, staging, ops, ops_full, done)
+        else:
+            set_max_registers(self.registers[0], increase=True)
+            self.scan(args, tid, first, stride, count, page, ops, dots, out_sums,
+                      state_full, state_empty, ops_full, done)  # fmt: skip

+    @cute.jit
+    def load_page(self, args, page, item, state_full):
+        head, request = item % self.heads, item // self.heads
+        slot = args[8][request, 0]
+        if slot > 0:
+            cute.arch.mbarrier_arrive_and_expect_tx(state_full, PAGE_BYTES)
+            source = args[9][Int64(slot), None, None, None]
+            for i in cutlass.range_constexpr(PAGE_BYTES // COPY_BYTES):
+                rows: cutlass.Constexpr = COPY_BYTES // (K * 4)
+                copy_g2s(
+                    page.iterator + i * rows * K,
+                    at(source, head, i * rows, 0),
+                    COPY_BYTES,
+                    state_full,
+                )
+        else:
+            cute.arch.mbarrier_arrive_and_expect_tx(state_full, 0)
+
+    # -------------------------------------------------------------- scan role
+    @cute.jit
+    def scan(self, args, t_g, first, stride, count, page, ops, dots, out_sums, state_full,  # noqa: E501
+             state_empty, ops_full, done):  # fmt: skip
+        xv_s, kp_s, dn_s, u_s, v_s, g_s, beta_s, pr_s, meta = ops
+        state, corrections = args[9], args[18]
+        T: cutlass.Constexpr = self.tokens
+        RQ: cutlass.Constexpr = corrections.shape[2]
+        lane_in, base_row = t_g % LANES, t_g // LANES
+        nw = args[12][t_g % K]
+        if t_g == 0:
+            self.load_page(args, page, first, state_full)
+        for j in cutlass.range(count, unroll=1):
+            b = 2 * (j % 2) + (j // 2) % 2  # operand block
+            following = first + (j + 1) * stride
+            wait(state_full, j % 2, scope="cta")
+            history = cute.make_rmem_tensor((ROWS, CHUNKS, 4), Float32)
+            for r in cutlass.range_constexpr(ROWS):
+                for c in cutlass.range_constexpr(CHUNKS):
+                    row = base_row + 32 * r
+                    values = load_shared_f32x4(
+                        page.iterator + row * K + 4 * (lane_in + LANES * c)

+                    for e in cutlass.range_constexpr(4):
+                        history[r, c, e] = values[e]
+            cute.arch.mbarrier_arrive(state_empty)
+            if t_g == 0:
+                wait(state_empty, j % 2, scope="cta")
+                if j + 1 < count:
+                    self.load_page(args, page, following, state_full)
+            wait(ops_full + b, (j // 4) % 2, scope="cta")

+                head, token, n = meta[b, 2], meta[b, 3], meta[b, 4]
+                rec, slot = meta[b, 5], meta[b, 6]
+                destination = state[Int64(slot), None, None, None]
+                # Replay: S_n = S_0 D_n + sum_t u_t (kn_t P_t), stored when n > 0.
+                u = cute.make_rmem_tensor((ROWS, RQ), Float32)
+                for r in cutlass.range_constexpr(ROWS):
+                    for t in cutlass.range_constexpr(RQ):
+                        u[r, t] = u_s[b, t, base_row + 32 * r]
+                for c in cutlass.range_constexpr(CHUNKS):
+                    key = 4 * (lane_in + LANES * c)
+                    d4 = load_shared_f32x4(at(dn_s, b, key))
+                    final = zeros((ROWS, 4), Float32)
+                    for t in cutlass.range_constexpr(RQ):
+                        k4 = load_shared_f32x4(at(kp_s, b, t, key))
+                        for r in cutlass.range_constexpr(ROWS):
+                            for pp in cutlass.range_constexpr(2):
+                                pair = fma2(
+                                    (u[r, t], u[r, t]),
+                                    (k4[2 * pp], k4[2 * pp + 1]),
+                                    (final[r, 2 * pp], final[r, 2 * pp + 1]),
+                                )
+                                final[r, 2 * pp], final[r, 2 * pp + 1] = pair
+                    for r in cutlass.range_constexpr(ROWS):
+                        for pp in cutlass.range_constexpr(2):
+                            pair = fma2(
+                                (history[r, c, 2 * pp], history[r, c, 2 * pp + 1]),
+                                (d4[2 * pp], d4[2 * pp + 1]),
+                                (final[r, 2 * pp], final[r, 2 * pp + 1]),
+                            )
+                            history[r, c, 2 * pp], history[r, c, 2 * pp + 1] = pair
+                        store_f32x4(
+                            at(destination, head, base_row + 32 * r, key),
+                            [history[r, c, e] for e in range(4)],
+                            n > 0,
+                        )

+                for half in cutlass.range_constexpr(2):
+                    acc = zeros((2, 2 * T, 2), Float32)
+                    for c in cutlass.range_constexpr(CHUNKS):
+                        key = 4 * (lane_in + LANES * c)
+                        for jj in cutlass.range_constexpr(2 * T):
+                            x4 = load_shared_f32x4(at(xv_s, b, jj, key))
+                            for rr in cutlass.range_constexpr(2):
+                                r = 2 * half + rr
+                                for pp in cutlass.range_constexpr(2):
+                                    pair = fma2(
+                                        (
+                                            history[r, c, 2 * pp],
+                                            history[r, c, 2 * pp + 1],
+                                        ),
+                                        (x4[2 * pp], x4[2 * pp + 1]),
+                                        (acc[rr, jj, 0], acc[rr, jj, 1]),
+                                    )
+                                    acc[rr, jj, 0], acc[rr, jj, 1] = pair
+                    for rr in cutlass.range_constexpr(2):
+                        red = [Float32(0) for _ in range(16)]
+                        for jj in cutlass.range_constexpr(2 * T):
+                            red[jj] = acc[rr, jj, 0] + acc[rr, jj, 1]
+                        selected = Int32(0)
+                        size = 16
+                        for offset in (4, 2, 1):
+                            size //= 2
+                            upper = (lane_in & offset) != 0
+                            for i in cutlass.range_constexpr(size):
+                                send = red[i] if upper else red[i + size]
+                                keep = red[i + size] if upper else red[i]
+                                red[i] = keep + cute.arch.shuffle_sync_bfly(
+                                    send, offset
+                                )
+                            if upper:
+                                selected += size
+                        row = base_row + 32 * (2 * half + rr)
+                        for i in cutlass.range_constexpr(2):
+                            if selected + i < 2 * T:
+                                dots[row, selected + i] = red[i]

+                # Per row (thread t_g < 128): the q x q substitution and the outputs
+                # (into the block's chunk vectors, read by now).
+                if t_g < K:
+                    us_new = zeros(T, Float32)
+                    for t in cutlass.range_constexpr(T):
+                        total = dots[t_g, t]
+                        for s in cutlass.range_constexpr(t):
+                            total = fma(pr_s[b, a_index(t, s)], us_new[s], total)
+                        us_new[t] = (v_s[b, t, t_g] - total) * beta_s[b, t]
+                    for t in cutlass.range_constexpr(T):
+                        o = dots[t_g, T + t]
+                        for s in cutlass.range_constexpr(t + 1):
+                            o = fma(pr_s[b, b_index(T, t, s)], us_new[s], o)

+                              out_sums[j % 2, None, None], nw)  # fmt: skip
+            cute.arch.mbarrier_arrive(done + b)

+    # -------------------------------------------------------------- prep role
+    @cute.jit
+    def prep(self, args, w, p, first, stride, count, staging, ops, ops_full, done):
+        x, weights, bias, conv_state, f_a, beta, a_log, dt_bias, slots = args[:9]
+        state, output, gate, norm_weight, lower_bound, scale, eps, f_b = args[9:17]
+        key_gates = args[19]
+        xv_s, kp_s, dn_s, u_s, v_s, g_s, beta_s, pr_s, meta = ops
+        convs, xs, gs, fas, sums, psums, kgs, us = staging
+        T: cutlass.Constexpr = self.tokens
+        H: cutlass.Constexpr = self.heads
+        RQ: cutlass.Constexpr = args[18].shape[2]
+        NP: cutlass.Constexpr = pair_count(T)
+        P2: cutlass.Constexpr = 1 << (NP - 1).bit_length()
+        NS: cutlass.Constexpr = 1 << (2 * T + RQ - 1).bit_length()  # norms
+        dim: cutlass.Constexpr = H * K
+        lane, warp = p % 32, p // 32
+        group_id, quarter = lane >> 2, lane & 3
+        c = p
+        bar = 1 + w
+        conv_type: cutlass.Constexpr = conv_state.element_type
+

+        if w >= count:
+            start = first
+        if w < count:
+            self.stage(args, staging, p, start)
+        cute.arch.cp_async_commit_group()
+
+        for j in cutlass.range(w, count, 2, unroll=1):
+            item = first + j * stride
+            head, request, slot, rec, n, offset = self.item_info(args, item)
+            token = request * T
+            blk = 2 * w + (j // 2) % 2
+            cute.arch.cp_async_wait_group(0)
